scope: Controlled constructive deduction by a small language model trained locally from random initialization. No broad-reasoning claim.
interface: Translated vectors are auxiliary training targets; recipient-only question evaluation uses no proof, encoder or translator at inference.

pilot.alpha_policy: minimum disjoint development validation answer NLL; see development.json

development.selection_metric: development validation answer NLL after fixed 64 recipient updates

ordinary_corpus.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
ordinary_corpus.author: Lewis Carroll
ordinary_corpus.license: Public domain in the USA; Project Gutenberg license retained in the local source file
ordinary_corpus.partition: Strip Gutenberg START/END markers, encode UTF-8; first 90 percent of bytes train, remainder validation, before training
ordinary_corpus.tokenizer: Fixed local UTF-8 byte vocabulary: PAD=0, BOS=1, EOS=2, bytes=3..258. No external tokenizer or weights.
ordinary_corpus.download: curl --fail --location https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11.txt.utf-8 --output RUN/corpus/alice.txt; preflight checks exact SHA-256 and refuses changed content

cost_note: Recipient update/token budgets are matched; bridge/proof-encoder costs are reported separately and are not a claim of equal end-to-end compute. Session timings may exclude earlier resumed sessions.

continuations.scope: Separate exploratory continuation; the registered main study remains immutable.

independent_verification.scope: Integrity and explicitly bounded independent replay; no conclusion about useful or sustained general reasoning transfer.

example.question:
Suppose snow; (if (wind and mist) then mist); wind; mist. Choose the implied statement.
A: (mist and snow)
B: (rain and mist)
Answer:
example.canonical_proof: p1;p2;p3;(if (p2 and p1) then p1)|-(p1 and p3):(And.intro (h3 (And.intro h1 h0)) h2)
example.solution:
Suppose snow; (if (wind and mist) then mist); wind; mist. Choose the implied statement.
A: (mist and snow)
B: (rain and mist)
Answer: A
Proof: (And.intro (h3 (And.intro h1 h0)) h2)

interpretation: Descriptive seed variability on fixed held-out structures; ties and negative deltas are retained. Low bridge error does not establish useful transfer.
